name: Conversation Café
deliverable: Structured four-round dialogue suppressing cross-talk on contentious issues

steps.text: Name one contentious question; set four rounds with a talking object in the center.
For three rounds, only the object holder speaks; no replies or side talk.
Open round four; ask what shifted your view.

failure: Cross-talk creeps in, two people debate, and the quiet members stop speaking before the later rounds.
intervention: Hold up the object and say no replies yet; we are here to understand, not to win this round.
provenance: Steps written for this deck from the method's public definition; the source has no protocol.

origin.title: The Surprising Power of Liberating Structures
